description: Solix Codex gate probe. TEMPORARY — remove when the run is done. Replace __PROBE_PATH__ with the absolute path to scripts/probe-codex-gate.sh. Copy to ~/.codex/hooks.json, but back up an existing ~/.codex/ first, and do NOT keep this alongside an inline [hooks] table in the same config.toml layer: Codex merges them and warns. Behaviour is read from PROBE_BEHAVIOR in the environment, so do not edit the script between runs — Codex records hook trust against the script's hash, and a changed script is skipped pending re-review, which looks exactly like a hook that never fired. See docs/CODEX-PROBE.md.
